newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait to form human rights committee - minister.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to form human rights committee - minister.

text.p: Kuwait's Interior Ministry will set up a human rights committee to investigate complaints, the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) reported on Monday night.

"Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad al-Khaled al-Sabah decided on Monday to form a human rights committee at the ministry with the task of following up complaints and devising solutions," the agency said.

The London-based Amnesty International last year said Kuwait's failure to deal with hundreds of human rights violations after the 1991 Gulf War was fanning fears that rights were being flouted with impunity in the oil-rich Gulf Arab state.
